{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Lok_Durd.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] wears a tunic of Ramordian silk adorned with expensive girdles and rank epaulets]]
'''Ramordian silk''' was a form of fabric<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> worn during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Trever Flume]] offered to sell a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] made of this material to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to replace his tattered [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], saying he would look good in it. The fabric turned out to have been stolen from [[Mariana's Exquisite Designs and Alterations]] just before.<ref name="The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref> A Ramordian silk tunic was worn by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]],<ref name="TCW Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> and [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] wore vibrant robes of Ramordian silk in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Sheets made out of Ramordian silk were found in the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra's]] quarters on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zothip]] and his gang of [[Cavrilhu Pirates]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" />
